title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts committed
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes three build artifacts under rust/target/debug/ that should not be version-controlled:

- rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d (depfile)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin (incremental cache)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock (incremental lock)

These are Rust compilation artifacts that pollute the repo and can cause merge conflicts and bloat. The rust/target/ directory should be in .gitignore. The files need to be removed from the index (git rm --cached).

The SosResource import fix in this commit is correct and should be retained.
